purpose_and_thesis: Not a built subsystem but the program's own ledger of itself. Read against the founding claim (README.md, written 2026-05-11: 'hallucinations as mutation, falsification as selection', kill geometry as trainable gradient field), the git history is the primary empirical record of whether the program converges, oscillates, or drifts — and of what it actually spends effort on versus what its docs claim it values.
strategic_read: The history is OSCILLATION WITH HONEST BOOKKEEPING, decaying into automation. Eight substrate eras in 14 weeks (Rhea forge → Apollo evolution → cartography tensor fleet → sigma/math substrate → industrial falsification swarm → science-of-failure/steering → dispatch sprint → reassessment), median era lifetime ~2.5 weeks, and each era ended the RIGHT way — with an explicit kill (Geometry 1 falsified, retraction cascade, Saxl reverted, fire loop paused at 90×0-promoted, Erebos ERRATA, Stage 0b stopped). The kill discipline is real and is the program's one consistently-honored value; the commit record is arguably the program's best artifact. But the record also shows the fatal asymmetry: selection without reproduction. 360M claimed kills, 90 consecutive fires with zero promotions, a promotion gate later shown to be 'shape-only' with a 'formula fossil' counter (b092b86a) — and the Learner that was supposed to eat the kill ledger has zero training commits since being declared the strategy on 2026-05-11. The program's stated payoff loop (kills → gradient field → training) has never once cycled. What the record says the program actually values, versus its docs: (1) falsification hygiene — genuinely practiced; (2) self-documentation — pivot/ is a superb graveyard; (3) automation of appearance — pronoia report-publishing started on founding day, and the portfolio heartbeat kept the commit graph green for 44 days while cognition was zero. What it does NOT value in practice: consolidation (every era's best artifact — sigma_kernel, the kill ledger, the dispatch scorer, the grading oracle — was orphaned at era's end), and cheap follow-through (the pre-scoped 800-gen Apollo run was never executed). Implication for where the program should go: the August resumption should be judged by whether it CLOSES loops rather than opens a ninth era. The three cheapest convergence tests already sit in the record: run the scoped Apollo 800-gen experiment, wire one consumer to the grading oracle, and retrain/measure MI on the current kill ledger against the README's 0.725-bit claim. If the resumed sessions instead start a new substrate, the archaeology predicts it dies by ~2026-09-01. Also: commit the Hephaestus working-tree changes — the program's provenance discipline, its best trait, is currently being bypassed.
